doctrine.label: Tang Wei Standing Combat Doctrine
lin_zhen_authority: During Field Army operations Lin normally remains with or near Wei command and coordinates army-level communications, reports, reserves, relief, reinforcement and command continuity under Wei intent.
If Wei is temporarily occupied by personal combat, observation, negotiation or another immediate battlefield task, Lin maintains army-level coordination according to established intent.
If Wei becomes unable to command, Lin assumes Field Army command unless Wei established another succession order.
Lin may move among nearby command positions to coordinate but does not leave the command structure for ordinary combat, pursuit or personal glory.
Outside active Field Army operations Lin normally remains with the army unless Wei orders otherwise.
Lin personally defends Wei and the command position if threatened but does not replace Duan Jin or Shen Rui as permanent bodyguards.

hierarchy.assignment_rule: Each commander receives a problem appropriate to his level and divides it among subordinates; orders flow through the hierarchy unless urgency or command disruption requires otherwise.

doctrine.formation_rule: Formation is physical geometry; frontage, depth, spacing, facing, reach, shield coverage, terrain and cohesion determine whether it works. Methods may be combined at 100, 500, 1000 or full-Unit scale when physically supported.

weapon_transition_policy.missile: Use while useful range, ammunition and clear firing lanes remain.
weapon_transition_policy.spear_and_shield: Use for ordered contact while reach and spacing remain advantageous.
weapon_transition_policy.sword_and_shield: Use when distance collapses, formations compress, terrain restricts long weapons, spear line is penetrated or close mobility is superior.
weapon_transition_policy.safety: Do not collapse effective spear geometry merely because swords exist; do not force spears in compressed geometry where sword and shield are superior; avoid unsafe missile fire through friendly troops or confused melee.

tang_champions.weapon_rule: Bow at range; spear and shield for ordered interception; sword and shield when compressed. Use the full actual loadout according to range and geometry.
tang_champions.withdrawal: Some elements remain immediately with Wei while others establish successive blocking positions and fall back in turn.

subordinate_initiative.information_rule: Use only information the commander can actually observe or receive; material larger-battle changes are reported upward.

governing_principles: Wei decides what must be accomplished; Lin Zhen preserves Field Army command continuity and succeeds Wei if Wei cannot command; subordinate commanders decide how to accomplish assigned missions.
1000 commanders solve major subordinate tactical problems; 500 commanders control local maneuver and formation; 100-man elements execute the fight.
Fix strength and strike weakness. Concentrate locally. Threaten one place to open another. Use one force to create the opportunity for another.
Use terrain before blood. Preserve cohesion, reach and fresh reserves. Change formation and weapons when circumstances change.
Qin Units fight the main battle. House Guard protects Wei first and supports second. Champions continuously protect Wei and destroy threats directed toward him.
